adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, member calendars are collected into `teamDestinationCalendars`, but `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` becomes a silent no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, discarding those member calendars. Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only honors destination calendars when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it falls back to the legacy branch, so the intended member destination calendars won’t be used.
